svg.text: AWS us-east-1 · 4 VPCs on one Transit Gateway · five microservices · every pipeline animated
Amazon EKS cluster · Istio + Calico + KEDA + Karpenter
CI/CD · Build, secure, push and deploy for all five microservices

Template every service follows (the pattern shown per lane below)
